cause: The changed native fault payload completed a warm-up and one injected generation on both cxi ranks. Rank 1 closed and rejoined with endpoint epoch 2 and a new incarnation; both ranks reported one reassignment, 134217728 logical replay bytes, exact independent reference roots, one old-epoch reject total, no partial commit, zero CQ/route errors, and terminal release. The validator incorrectly applied the clean physical-contribution equality before its fault branch: fault wire contribution is exactly layout_bytes plus one 67108864-byte remote replay shard, while the other logical replay shard is applied on its local native owner and intentionally does not enter physical wire accounting.
correction: Make physical contribution accounting mode-specific and fail closed: clean must equal layout_bytes; fault must equal layout_bytes plus exactly one payload_max remote replay. Keep physical redistribution equal to layout_bytes and keep the existing per-rank logical replay requirement of exactly two payload_max values. Add regression coverage for both accepted and off-by-one replay accounting. Also invoke pre-submit attestation with NDP_PYTHON_BIN rather than a login-node shebang.
